_note: The writer list (BUILD-SPEC B6). A use is allowed unless a clause in the maker's licence or terms restricts it (the maintainer's rule, 2026-10-17: silence is not a restriction). Each entry records the terms search: terms_url (the maker's live page), terms_date (the day it was read), checked_by, registry_id (its record in rnd licences/registry.json) and training (allowed, conditions or barred); terms_note keeps what was read. role-set refuses an entry without that record, or one whose verdict is barred. A listed model is still refused until it is pinned: repo revision, GGUF file and its sha256, filled in after the download. The wave script measures the GGUF and the llama-server binary before launch and the run refuses any drift. A critic of the writer's own family is refused. Cloud tags are refused regardless (the Ollama Cloud spending rule).

llama_server.note: llama.cpp built with CUDA 13.4 on each host; pinned by commit and binary sha256 once built
